nota: Ordem importa: a primeira regra que casar com o título define a função. Aderência é ao perfil Projetos, Agilidade e Delivery.

roles.label: Agile Coach
roles.regex: agile coach|agilist|agile lead\b|lean.?agile|coach [aá]gil|agile transformation|ways of working|enterprise agil

roles.label: Delivery Manager
roles.regex: delivery (manager|lead|director|head|executive|owner|partner)|head of delivery|engagement (manager|director|lead)|gerente de (entrega|delivery)|l[ií]der de delivery|delivery management

roles.label: Scrum Master
roles.regex: scrum master|squad lead|l[ií]der de squad|team facilitator

roles.label: Program Manager
roles.regex: program(me)? manager|program lead|program director|technical program|\bTPM\b|gerente de programas?

roles.label: PMO e Coordenação
roles.regex: \bPMO\b|project coordinator|coordenador(a)? de projetos?|portfolio manager|project analyst|analista de projetos|project management office|project specialist|especialista (em|de) projetos|project controller|project administrator

roles.label: Product Manager
roles.regex: product manager|gerente de produto|head of product|product lead|product director|group product

roles.label: Project Manager
roles.regex: project manager|project lead|projects? director|gerente de projetos?|gestor(a)? de projetos?|implementation manager|project management lead|\bIT PM\b|project management

exclude: construction|civil eng|electrical|mechanical|hvac|solar|real estate|architectur|interior design|clinical|medical|nurse|nursing|pharmac|investment|wealth|asset management|trading|insurance agent|recruiter|talent acquisition|sales manager|account executive|intern\b|estagi|volunteer|unpaid|executive assistant|assistente executiv
